newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates rise on recent NCD issues.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates rise on recent NCD issues.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates rose at mid-session on Wednesday following the central bank's recent issues of negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up market liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.984 percent against Tuesday's 5.816 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.00 percent against 5.75-6.00.
Dealers said they expected the rates to stabilise because the central bank had refrained on Wednesday from launching further mop-up measures.
